leaders.one_liner: Privacy-focused L2 on both Polkadot and OP Stack that failed to differentiate; near-zero TVL and activity in 2026

leaders.name: MCDEX
leaders.one_liner: Decentralized perp exchange using AMM. MCDEX V3 on Arbitrum.

leaders.name: Band Protocol
leaders.one_liner: Alternative oracle network that briefly challenged Chainlink in 2020-2021 but has since been almost entirely displaced; no meaningful recovery signals

leaders.name: Neo
leaders.one_liner: Chinese Ethereum from 2017 with dual-token model (NEO+GAS); the 'smart economy' never materialized

leaders.name: Ribbon Finance
leaders.one_liner: Structured products protocol (covered calls, puts) that pioneered on-chain options vaults but has been rendered largely obsolete by Aevo and Lyra

leaders.name: Spell Token
leaders.one_liner: Governance token for Abracadabra Money (MIM stablecoin), permanently impaired by Wonderland scandal and UST contagion; no recovery path evident

leaders.name: The Sandbox
leaders.one_liner: -99.4% ATH. 4,500 DAU. Founders ousted. 50% layoffs. Staking dead. $312K daily vol. Metaverse narrative buried.

leaders.name: Zilliqa
leaders.one_liner: 2018-era sharding chain that lost the scalability race; GameFi pivot failed to gain traction

leaders.name: Qtum
leaders.one_liner: 2017-era Bitcoin UTXO + Ethereum EVM hybrid; technically obsolete and network is a ghost town

leaders.name: Kadena
leaders.one_liner: PoW blockchain with 20-chain sharding that promised infinite scale; network is effectively dead

leaders.name: Harmony
leaders.one_liner: Sharded L1 permanently damaged by the $100M Horizon bridge hack; trust destroyed, network never recovered
